reason: Broad planner-core refactor around the physical sort operator, touching optimizer task selection, implementation/enforcer rules, cost models, plan cloning/cache, explain/stringer, resolve-indices, plan-to-PB, and executor builder paths. Even if framed as classification/cleanup, sort is a central physical operator and this spread across core planner/executor modules has meaningful risk of hidden high-severity regressions in plan correctness, costing, or runtime plan construction.
